description.value: Silver Star Liquor Store is a 100% locally owned and operated alcohol retailer that has served Vernon since June 2008. Located at the corner of Silver Star Road and Pleasant Valley Road on the parking lot side of the historic Butcher Boys Grocery building — a family site since 1961 — it carries a broad selection of beer, wine, ciders, spirits, and BC craft options. Cyclists on the Silver Star corridor can stop to pick up packaged beverages, though the store offers no dedicated cycling services.

address.value: 4803 Pleasant Valley Road, Vernon, BC V1B 3L7
